header: DK-atlas (104 class) MeshNet: 24-channel, 13-layer gridding-free deep dilation (RF ~= 256^3).
comment: Symmetric coprime dilation ramp 1,3,5,7,13,19,31,19,13,7,5,3,1 (13 conv layers + final 1x1). RF = 1+2*sum = 255 voxels -> matched to the 256 cube. All rates are odd, gcd is 1, and a dilation=1 layer is present, so the aggregate receptive field has no gridding holes (Wang et al., WACV 2018). Capacity comes from depth, not width: peak activation memory stays at channels x 256^3 (one buffer reused per layer), comparable to the 21-channel model it replaces. NO skip/residual connections (anti-U-Net); trainability of the deep plain stack relies on per-channel GroupNorm in every block, hence affine=true (learnable scale+shift). Hidden convs are bias-free (GroupNorm removes the need); only the final 1x1 classifier conv carries a bias. Trained with GELU activations.
